fullPassage: The human brain, it turns out, has shrunk in mass by about 10 percent since it peaked in size 15,000-30,000 years ago. One possible reason is that many thousands of years ago humans lived in a world of dangerous predators where they had to have their wits about them at all times to avoid being killed. Today, we have effectively domesticated ourselves and many of the tasks of survival — from avoiding immediate death to building shelters to obtaining food — have been outsourced to the wider society. We are smaller than our ancestors too, and it is a characteristic of domestic animals that they are generally smaller than their wild cousins. None of this may mean we are dumber — brain size is not necessarily an indicator of human intelligence — but it may mean that our brains today are wired up differently, and perhaps more efficiently, than those of our ancestors.

questions.passage: The human brain, it turns out, has shrunk in mass by about 10 percent since it peaked in size 15,000-30,000 years ago. One possible reason is that many thousands of years ago humans lived in a world of dangerous predators where they had to have their wits about them at all times to avoid being killed. Today, we have effectively domesticated ourselves and many of the tasks of survival — from avoiding immediate death to building shelters to obtaining food — have been outsourced to the wider society. We are smaller than our ancestors too, and it is a characteristic of domestic animals that they are generally smaller than their wild cousins. <u>None of this may mean</u> we are dumber — brain size is not necessarily an indicator of human intelligence — but it may mean that our brains today are wired up differently, and perhaps more efficiently, than those of our ancestors.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>None of this</u>에서 this가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
본문: 뇌가 약 10% 줄고, 우리가 조상보다 작으며, 가축이 야생 사촌보다 작다는 내용 뒤에 'None of this may mean we are dumber'

✅ ① 뇌 축소·몸집 축소 등 일련의 사실들: this는 앞서 설명된 여러 사실 전체를 가리킴 ← 정답

det.analysis:
❌ ① disappeared completely(완전히 사라졌다): 문맥 부적합

✅ ② peaked in size(크기가 정점에 이르렀다): 'has shrunk in mass by about 10 percent since it __________ 15,000-30,000 years ago' — 1만5천~3만 년 전 크기가 정점에 이른 이후 줄어듦 ← 정답

❌ ③ suddenly changed its shape(갑자기 모양이 바뀌었다): 본문 근거 없음

❌ ④ stopped working entirely(완전히 작동을 멈췄다): 문맥 부적합
det.tip: peaked in size = 크기가 정점에 이르렀다 (이후 shrunk)
